Since then the University has chartered an illustrious history of 65 golden years of academic achievements and intellectual leadership. It was envisaged by the decision makers that the spread of education especially higher education would lead to deeper socio – economic development. The achievements of the University has been recognized and documented by the National Assessment and Accreditation Council in 2024, when it awarded a high rating of “A Grade” with CGPA score 3.22. We are striving for an even better rating in next accreditation.  The University covers a vast arena of disciplines and encompasses various faculties such as Science, Arts, Social Science, Commerce, Law, Management and Education.
